name: MITF (splash white)
summary: The first of two splash-white loci (with PAX3): white over the legs, belly and face, often a broad blaze and blue eyes, dominant and very variable in extent. UC Davis recognises six MITF splash variants - SW1, SW3, SW5, SW6, SW7 and SW8; SW1 is the widespread one (allele frequency up to 0.10 in Miniature Horses, 0.076 in Icelandic Horses and 0.053 in Paint Horses) and the rest are rare or confined to a family. SW9, published in 2023 and not on UC Davis's list, is a missense change, c.993A>T (chromosome 16, 21,559,940 A>T on EquCab3.0), found in Pura Raza Espanola (Andalusian) horses with splashed white markings and blue eyes; the evidence is an association study, and it is known only from that breed so far. No horse with two copies of SW3, SW5, SW6, SW7, SW8 or SW9 has been detected; UC Davis says such pairs may be lethal as embryos and advises against breeding two SW3 carriers, and at least one laboratory states SW3/SW3 as lethal to the embryo; the absence of a report is not proof. No outcome is published for a pair of two different variants. Splash is two genes, so a horse can carry a copy here and a copy at PAX3 and be whiter than either alone. Some splash-white horses, but not all, are deaf, and SW5 is reported with a raised risk. No genotype is confirmed by a source to cause deafness, so none is marked with it here.

alleles.name: Splash white 9 (c.993A>T, missense; Pura Raza Espanola)

phenotypes.name: Splash white
phenotypes.description: One splash variant. Typically a broad blaze, white legs with a clean, sharply bounded edge, white on the belly and often blue eyes - but expression varies enormously: the same genotype can show no more than a star and a sock, or a great deal of white. No rule that one variant gives more white than another is established.

phenotypes.name: Bold splash white
phenotypes.description: Two copies of the same variant, where that pair is known alive. More white than one copy gives, and such a horse may be very extensively or entirely white.

phenotypes.name: Splash white, pair not documented
phenotypes.description: Two different MITF splash variants. No outcome is published for any such pair. More white than one variant gives is expected, and such a horse can be extensively white, but the exact outcome is variable and not characterised; no consistent appearance should be assumed.

phenotypes.name: Two copies, never detected
phenotypes.description: No horse with two copies of this variant has been detected. UC Davis says such homozygotes may be lethal as embryos, and at least one laboratory states it for SW3; that is not established, and the absence of a report is not proof.
